references.text: Continues the description of the Emim and compares them to the Anakim, who were also called Rephaim
Describes another great and numerous people, the Rephaim, who were also as tall as the Anakim
Mentions the Emim in Shaveh-Kiriathaim, showing their historical settlement
Describes the Anakim as giants (Nephilim), a great and mighty people
Refers to the Anakim as a great and tall people against whom no one could stand
Tells how Joshua destroyed the Anakim from the hill country
First mention of the Rephaim, among whom the Emim were counted
